page: Amazon Web Services im4gn.xlarge is a storage-optimized instance powered by a custom 64-bit ARM architecture. It features 4 dedicated physical cores utilizing the AWS Graviton Neoverse-N1 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 16.0 GB of memory, providing 4.0 GB per core, and includes a 32 MB L3 cache. Storage is a key highlight, featuring 1875 GB of local NVMe SSD capacity. The instance operates on the Nitro hypervisor and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate average performance in stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU tests, alongside average large-block memory bandwidth read and write speeds. However, the instance exhibits weaker performance in memory bandwidth for small blocks and single-threaded gzip compression. Passmark database operations score in the average range, while cryptographic operations, text processing, and LLM inference tasks fall into the poor or weak categories.

Given its high local NVMe SSD storage capacity relative to its 4 vCPUs, the im4gn.xlarge offers a resource-dense profile for storage-heavy workloads. The combination of dedicated ARM cores and local NVMe storage makes this instance suitable for database operations, caching layers, and applications requiring fast local storage access, though it is less suited for compute-intensive or high-performance cryptographic tasks.
